nodes.label: Home screen PWA store screenshot (mobile)
nodes.rationale: Portrait phone screenshot for the PWA manifest/install sheet. It shows the public marketing landing page, not the admin dashboard.

nodes.label: Live branch open/closed status ticker with Check In link
nodes.rationale: The top strip shows 'CLOSED - Tadepalli opens 16:00' and cycles between branches, so visitors see real-time hours. 'CHECK IN' gives members a quick way into door check-in.

nodes.label: Header: Stars Gym logo, Join Now pill CTA, hamburger menu
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first layout: the nav collapses into a hamburger and only the main conversion action (Join Now) stays visible.

nodes.label: Hero: 'STARS GYM' solid/outline display type, 'Earn your star.' tagline over gym photo
nodes.rationale: Bold, athletic brand look: condensed display type, dark photo overlay, and a red accent on the word 'STAR' as a pun on the brand name. Copy names both branches (Mandadam & Tadepalli) and the three core flows: buy online, check in at the door, and the streak wall.

nodes.label: Primary 'Book a Trial Day' and secondary 'See Plans' buttons
nodes.rationale: Clear primary/secondary hierarchy: a filled red button for the trial (the low-commitment entry) and an outlined button for browsing membership plans.

nodes.label: Streak wall (attendance gamification)
nodes.rationale: Hero copy says 'climb the streak wall', which suggests a leaderboard of members ranked by check-in streak.

nodes.label: Brand palette: red #E3141B-ish on near-black, white type
nodes.rationale: High-contrast red on black matches the logo and is used on every CTA.
